enemies.name: Candle-Bearer
enemies.desc: A novice holding the last clean candle in the cathedral. If it goes out, they all do.

enemies.name: Flesh Altar
enemies.desc: Heals every enemy at the start of their turn. Destroy them all.

encounters.name: The Penitents
encounters.desc: Flagellants grow stronger every time they are hurt. Finish them in one go.
encounters.intro: They hurt themselves so you don't have to. They would still like to help.

encounters.name: Choir Practice
encounters.desc: While the choir sings, using the same card twice in a row hurts. Vary your play, or silence them first.
encounters.intro: Choir practice. Don't sing along, and don't repeat yourself.

encounters.name: Out of the Walls
encounters.desc: A swarm of wretches. Weak alone. Area attacks shine.
encounters.intro: The walls have been breeding again.

encounters.name: The Collection
encounters.desc: The tithe collector steals cards for two rounds at a time and carries a lot of gold.
encounters.intro: Time for the collection. Give generously. It will take the rest.

encounters.name: Theatre of Surgery
encounters.desc: The surgeon-deacon keeps stitching flagellants back together. Every patient comes back mutated: stronger, but softer.
encounters.intro: The surgeon will see you now. The surgeon will see you whether you like it or not.

encounters.name: The Growth in the Pulpit
encounters.desc: Destroy the tumour. It buds wretches and grows stronger every turn nobody hurts it. The rest don't matter.
encounters.intro: It started as a sermon. It got out of hand.

encounters.name: Three Altars
encounters.desc: Three altars heal every enemy each turn. Destroy all three to win; the congregation can be ignored.
encounters.intro: Three altars. Three times the healing. Three times the problem.

encounters.name: The Last Clean Candle
encounters.desc: Keep the candle-bearer alive. Enemies arrive in rounds 2 and 3.
encounters.intro: Somebody here is still praying properly. Keep them at it.

encounters.name: Between the Pews
encounters.desc: They were waiting in the pews and they move first.
encounters.intro: They were already sitting down when you came in. Rude to interrupt.

encounters.name: Hymn Number Six
encounters.desc: Three choirboys behind pillars and a surgeon. Psychic damage from range, and repeating a card hurts.
encounters.intro: Hymn number six. All the verses. Even the ones nobody sings.

encounters.name: Claim Sanctuary
encounters.desc: Survive 4 rounds until the bells stop. The holy ground in the middle heals heroes who start their turn on it.
encounters.intro: Four rounds. Then the bells stop and everyone goes home. Mostly.

encounters.name: The Deacon's Escort
encounters.desc: Kill the senior surgeon (the elite deacon) and the rest lose heart.
encounters.intro: The senior surgeon is passing through. With an escort.

encounters.name: The Ossuary
encounters.desc: Bones and a pit. Shoving flagellants into the pit is one way to stop them growing.
encounters.intro: Mind the pit. Everyone else did, eventually.

encounters.name: Feast Day
encounters.desc: A feast with a growing tumour, a surgeon and a collector. Kill the tumour early or drown in wretches.
encounters.intro: Feast day. Everyone brings something. The floor brings itself.

encounters.name: The Weeping Reliquary
encounters.desc: It grows more dangerous every turn nobody hurts it, and winds up a Lamentation around itself. Keep it busy, step out when it winds up.
encounters.intro: A box of saints. They are not resting.

encounters.name: The Martyrs' Procession
encounters.desc: Two veteran flagellants and a surgeon. Every blow makes them stronger.
encounters.intro: The martyrs. They have practised suffering until it became a skill.

encounters.name: Tithe Day
encounters.desc: The collectors are out in force. Expect to lose cards for a while.
encounters.intro: Tithe day. They take ten percent. Of you.

encounters.name: The Grafted
encounters.desc: Two master surgeons heal each other and everyone else. Split them up.
encounters.intro: Two surgeons who have operated on each other for a very long time.

encounters.name: The Fraudulent Saint
encounters.desc: She heals her congregation. Below 60% she inverts healing for two rounds at a time: healing your heroes then hurts them. Check the rule rack before you heal.
encounters.intro: She heals everyone. She has never once been asked to.

encounters.name: The Choir of One
encounters.desc: It sings echoes of itself onto the board; its Crescendo grows with every echo standing, and echoes burst when they die. Repeating a card hurts while it sings.
encounters.intro: One voice. It sings every part.
